name: Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel

address.street: Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel Hotel

insider_take: This iconic tower has been Mexico City's most prestigious address since 1969, standing guard over the famous Angel of Independence monument like a golden sentinel in the heart of Zona Rosa.
whats_special: The hotel's prime location directly faces the Angel of Independence, one of Mexico City's most photographed landmarks. Built during Mexico's golden age of hospitality, it was the country's first international luxury hotel and has hosted everyone from heads of state to Hollywood stars. The property sits at the intersection of Paseo de la Reforma and Zona Rosa, putting you at the epicenter of the city's cultural and business districts.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 15-23 facing Paseo de la Reforma for unobstructed views of the Angel of Independence - these rooms offer the perfect backdrop for sunrise photos with the monument illuminated below.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar offers panoramic views of the sprawling metropolis and distant volcanoes on clear days. Take an evening stroll to the Angel of Independence (literally across the street) when it's beautifully illuminated, then explore the vibrant nightlife and shopping of Zona Rosa just steps from your door.
pros: Prime location on Paseo de la Reforma near major attractions
Iconic hotel with classic Mexican hospitality and heritage
Full-service amenities including fitness center and business facilities
Easy access to Zona Rosa entertainment district
cons: Older property with traditional decor may feel dated
Urban location in busy commercial district
